points.K3: 写给第一次上实验课的你
points.K4: 实验技术回答哪些问题
points.K6: 课前复习萃取、色谱、蒸馏
points.K7: 先学基础，再学专门技术
points.S1: 先培训、考核，再进实验室
points.S3: 看标签，读安全技术说明书

shots.scene: 欣欣穿着实验服、戴护目镜，站在化学实验室门口招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, wearing a lab coat and safety goggles, stands at the door of a chemistry teaching lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎走进化学实验室！
overlay: 走进化学实验室：技术与安全的第一课

shots.scene: 烧杯、分液漏斗、冷凝管、护目镜四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a beaker, a separatory funnel, a condenser and a pair of safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 这一课，先认识技术，再系好安全带。

shots.scene: 阿杰抱着课本站在实验室门外，一脸紧张
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands outside a chemistry lab door holding a blank textbook, looking nervous.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次上化学实验课，有点慌。

shots.scene: 阿杰想直接推门进去，小研拦住他，递来护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches for the lab door; the female graduate student stops him and hands him a pair of safety goggles.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先别急，准备好再进。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 会做实验，从懂原理和守规矩开始。

shots.section_title: 动手做，才能真正懂化学
shots.scene: 欣欣捧着一本空白书，旁边漂浮着分子球棍模型
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a closed blank book while a ball-and-stick molecule model floats beside it.
shots.narration: 书上的分子，看得见却摸不着。
overlay: 动手做，才能真正懂化学

shots.section_title: 动手做，才能真正懂化学
shots.scene: 小研在实验台前专注观察烧瓶中溶液变色
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat and goggles watches a solution in a flask change color at a lab bench.
shots.narration: 亲手做一次，理解会深得多。

shots.scene: 四个图标：烧瓶反应、仪器分析、数据曲线、问号变灯泡
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a reacting flask, an analytical instrument, a data curve on a blank chart, and a question mark turning into a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 这套课学做反应、学分析技术。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着空白坐标图上的曲线，若有所思
shots.prompt_en: The young male student studies a curve on a blank chart printout and taps his chin thoughtfully.
shots.narration: 还要学会读数据、解决问题。

shots.section_title: 写给第一次上实验课的你
shots.scene: 实验台上摆满各种仪器，天平、加热台、玻璃器皿
shots.prompt_en: A lab bench with many instruments: a balance, a hot plate stirrer and assorted glassware, all with blank labels. No people.
shots.narration: 化学实验离不开各种专门仪器。
overlay: 写给第一次上实验课的你

shots.section_title: 写给第一次上实验课的你
shots.scene: 几名学生戴护目镜在实验台前围看老师示范
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student, both in lab coats and goggles, watch the older man demonstrate at a bench.
shots.narration: 这套课写给第一次上实验课的同学。

shots.section_title: 写给第一次上实验课的你
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白实验报告，露出自信微笑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank lab report sheet and smiles with confidence.
shots.narration: 看懂了再做，心里就有底。

shots.section_title: 实验技术回答哪些问题
shots.scene: 一瓶未知液体旁边打着问号
shots.prompt_en: A bottle of clear liquid with a blank label and a large question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 这瓶东西到底是什么？
overlay: 实验技术回答哪些问题

shots.section_title: 实验技术回答哪些问题
shots.scene: 烧瓶旁的沙漏和问号
shots.prompt_en: A round-bottom flask on a stand next to an hourglass and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 反应什么时候算做完了？

shots.section_title: 实验技术回答哪些问题
shots.scene: 密闭手套箱图标，里面是一个烧瓶，外面有空气图标被挡住
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sealed glove box with a flask inside and air symbols blocked outside. No people.
shots.narration: 怕空气的物质又该怎么操作？

shots.section_title: 实验技术回答哪些问题
shots.scene: 欣欣翻开一本旧相册，里面是老式玻璃仪器的线描图
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens an old album showing line drawings of old-fashioned glassware.
shots.narration: 学会这些，更懂前辈化学家的贡献。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着两本空白书：普通化学、有机化学
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at two stacked blank textbooks on a desk.
shots.narration: 普通化学和有机化学原理是基础。

shots.scene: 阿杰看操作演示，头顶冒出一串问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student watches a demonstration with several question marks above his head.
shots.narration: 原理不懂，看操作就会一头雾水。

shots.section_title: 课前复习萃取、色谱、蒸馏
shots.scene: 三张空白卡片：分液漏斗、色谱柱、蒸馏装置图标
shots.prompt_en: Three blank cards with icons: a separatory funnel, a chromatography column, and a distillation setup. No people.
shots.narration: 萃取、色谱、蒸馏，课前先复习。
overlay: 课前复习萃取、色谱、蒸馏

shots.section_title: 课前复习萃取、色谱、蒸馏
shots.scene: 小研在书桌前预习，旁边放着空白笔记
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student studies at a desk with a blank notebook and a laptop showing a blank screen.
shots.narration: 带着原理进实验室，做起来更明白。

shots.section_title: 先学基础，再学专门技术
shots.scene: 台阶图标：低台阶是基础技术，高台阶是专门技术
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon with a small flask on the lower steps and a complex apparatus on the top step. No people.
shots.narration: 先学人人必会的基础技术。
overlay: 先学基础，再学专门技术

shots.section_title: 先学基础，再学专门技术
shots.scene: 欣欣站在台阶顶端向上指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands on the top of a staircase icon and points upward.
shots.narration: 再学有机实验的专门操作和合成。

shots.scene: 老周在实验台前示范，阿杰认真记笔记
shots.prompt_en: The older man in a lab coat and goggles demonstrates at a bench while the young male student takes notes.
shots.narration: 操作要跟有经验的老师学。

shots.scene: 老周拍拍阿杰肩膀，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The older man pats the young male student on the shoulder and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 不懂就问，经验比蛮干更可靠。

shots.section_title: 先培训、考核，再进实验室
shots.scene: 王老师在培训室讲课，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group of students in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，先接受安全教育。
overlay: 先培训、考核，再进实验室

shots.section_title: 先培训、考核，再进实验室
shots.scene: 阿杰在电脑前答题，屏幕空白，旁边一张空白合格证
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes a test on a computer with a blank screen; a blank certificate card lies beside the keyboard.
shots.narration: 考核通过，取得准入，才能进门做实验。

shots.section_title: 先培训、考核，再进实验室
shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三个建筑图标连成一串
shots.prompt_en: Three linked icons in a chain: a university building, a department building and a lab room. No people.
shots.narration: 遵守学校和实验室的安全规定。

shots.scene: 小研示范穿戴：实验服、护目镜、手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a buttoned lab coat, safety goggles and nitrile gloves in front of a mirror.
shots.narration: 实验服扣好，护目镜戴上。

shots.scene: 小研把长发扎起，脚穿包脚鞋
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties her long hair back; close view of her closed-toe shoes.
shots.narration: 长发束起，穿不露脚的鞋。

shots.scene: 拖鞋、短裤、披发三个图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: slippers, shorts and loose long hair, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 拖鞋短裤、披头散发，都不行。

shots.scene: 手套图标旁有化学品瓶，手套按化学品选择
shots.prompt_en: Several glove icons of different materials beside a chemical bottle with a blank label and a matching check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 手套要按所用化学品来选。

shots.scene: 实验台上的水杯和零食被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A cup of drink and a snack on a lab bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不吃不喝，不用手揉眼。

shots.section_title: 看标签，读安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 试剂瓶上的GHS象形图特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a reagent bottle with GHS hazard pictograms: flame, exclamation mark and corrosion. No people.
shots.narration: 用试剂前，先看清标签和危险图示。
overlay: 看标签，读安全技术说明书

shots.section_title: 看标签，读安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 小研翻阅一份空白的安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a thick blank safety data sheet booklet at a desk.
shots.narration: 再查安全技术说明书，了解危害和急救。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在通风柜前，柜门拉到较低位置
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a fume hood with the sash pulled down to a low working height.
shots.narration: 挥发、有毒的操作放进通风柜。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜内操作，手臂伸入，脸在柜门外
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works with her hands inside a fume hood while her face stays behind the lowered sash.
shots.narration: 头别伸进去，柜门按规定高度。

shots.scene: 通风柜内堆满瓶子的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fume hood crammed with bottles blocking the back vents, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 柜里别堆杂物，不当储存柜用。

shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above a lab eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 进门先找洗眼器在哪里。

shots.scene: 紧急喷淋标志、灭火器、灭火毯排成一行
shots.prompt_en: An emergency shower sign, a fire extinguisher and a fire blanket in a row on a lab wall. No people.
shots.narration: 紧急喷淋、灭火器、灭火毯，也要认清。

shots.scene: 安全出口标志和疏散路线箭头
shots.prompt_en: An emergency exit sign above a door with green evacuation arrows on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 记住安全出口和疏散路线。

shots.scene: 阿杰在洗眼器前冲洗眼睛，小研在旁扶着
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses his eyes at an eyewash station while the female graduate student supports him.
shots.narration: 化学品溅入眼睛，立即用洗眼器冲洗。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告情况
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports an incident to the older man at the lab doorway; he listens and nods.
shots.narration: 马上报告老师和实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有火焰和红十字图标
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a flame icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 着火拨打119，急救拨打120。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现书本、烧瓶、台阶图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a book, a flask and a staircase.
shots.narration: 先懂原理，再学操作，由浅入深。

shots.scene: 合格证、护目镜、试剂标签三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a blank certificate, safety goggles and a bottle label with hazard pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 培训准入、穿戴防护、看清标签。

shots.scene: 通风柜、洗眼器、电话三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fume hood, an eyewash station and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 会用通风柜，认得应急设施，会报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研在实验室门口一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera with the young male student and the female graduate student at a lab door, all in lab coats and goggles.
shots.narration: 带好安全，一起去做化学吧！
